newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian car sales seen at 2.2 mln in 1997 -- Anfia.
newsitem.headline: Italian car sales seen at 2.2 mln in 1997 -- Anfia.

text.p: Italian new car registrations are set to reach 2.2 million in 1997 after the month of May saw a record level of new registrations at 232,600, said Italian carmaker association Anfia on Tuesday.
Anfia added that Italian new car registration in the first five months of 1997 had risen to 1,089,600, a level not seen since the record year of 1992.
An Anfia statement added that the average age of an Italian car on the road is the oldest in Europe at 14 years.
In 1992, Italian new car registrations reached a record of 2.389 million, but the market slipped back in 1993 and reached only 1.737 million in 1996.
